title: Integrate BCH + LDPC + interleaver + QAM into unified FEC chain
description:
## Goal

Build the complete DVB-T2 BICM processing chain by composing the
already-existing or in-flight component pieces into a single end-to-end
pipeline with stable interfaces between stages:

```
BBFRAME → BCH encode → LDPC encode → bit interleave → QAM map
                                                            ↓
                                                          AWGN
                                                            ↓
        BCH decode ← LDPC decode ← bit deinterleave ← QAM demap
```

This is the integration story that the campaign runner (`152388f4`)
consumes. It does NOT include the runner binary, the simulation
harness, or the test-vector validation — those are sibling tasks.

## Context

Components present or in-flight (cited as their JIT short IDs):

- BCH outer encoder/decoder — done, all 12 DVB-T2 configs
  (`crates/gf2-coding/src/bch/dvb_t2/`).
- LDPC inner encoder/decoder — done, all 12 DVB-T2 parity tables in
  Rust consts (`crates/gf2-coding/src/ldpc/dvb_t2/`); raw `.txt`
  source files for 11/12 still pending (`cef2e631`).
- BCH+LDPC concatenation API — task `a18956a4` (NEW-1 of this epic).
- DVB-T2 column-row bit interleaver — task `87a2402f`.
- Gray-QAM mapper / soft demapper — done (`d4851c3d` epic closed),
  located in `crates/gf2-coding/src/modem/`.

The 3 in-scope (rate × modulation) configurations are
Normal × {1/2, 2/3, 3/4} × {16-QAM, 64-QAM}. Other configurations
may be wired but are not required by this story.

## Deliverables

1. A single public type — e.g. `DvbT2BicmChain` — exposing the
   forward (transmit) and inverse (receive) chain in a single call,
   with constructor `DvbT2BicmChain::new(frame_size, code_rate,
   modulation)`.
2. Internally delegates to:
   - the BCH+LDPC concat codec (`a18956a4`),
   - the DVB-T2 bit interleaver (`87a2402f`),
   - the existing Gray-QAM mapper / demapper.
3. Module placement under `crates/gf2-coding/src/ldpc/dvb_t2/` so the
   spec-specific glue stays colocated with the inner code (final
   placement at implementer's choice).
4. Roundtrip unit tests on all 3 × 2 in-scope configurations
   (transmit then receive at very high SNR — should recover the
   payload bit-exact).
5. Documentation: rustdoc with the standard sections plus a chain
   diagram. CLAUDE.md module map updated.

## Success criteria

- [hard] All 3 × 2 in-scope configurations round-trip random
  payloads bit-exact at very high SNR (effectively noiseless).
- [hard] The chain is wired end-to-end through the
  bit-interleaver-aware path; the TP07a vector validation
  (`4cdaf1c5`) is satisfied via this chain.
- [hard] No new `unsafe`; satisfies `#![deny(unsafe_code)]`.
- [hard] Public API has rustdoc with the standard sections.
- [hard] CLAUDE.md gf2-coding module map updated.

## Non-goals

- No AWGN simulation harness changes — that is in NEW-INFRA
  (`fd73e8a8`).
- No campaign binary, CSV, or plotting — that is in NEW-2
  (`152388f4`).
- No production campaign runs — that is in `e4849f07`.
- No fading or non-AWGN channels.
- 9 out-of-scope LDPC configurations may panic with
  `unimplemented!` or return `Err`.
